content: अभिचर् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To act wrongly towards any one, offend, trespass; तत्र विराधदनुकबन्धप्रभृतयः केऽप्यभिचरन्तीति श्रुतम् <ls>Mv. 2</ls>. .²2 To be faithless (as wife or husband) पतिं या नाभिचरति मनोवाग्देहसंयता <ls>Ms. 5. 165</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 102</ls>. .²3 To charm, conjure, exorcise (by spell or incantations), employ spells for magical purposes <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>Rv. 10. 34. 14</ls>; वृष्टयायुःपुष्टिकामो वा तथैवाभिचरन्नपि <ls>Y. 1. 295</ls>, <ls n="Y.">3. 288</ls>. .²4 to possess, occupy.
